I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November. That's what Ilse posted in that channel on 14 October, and nothing later in the channel changes it.

- **Access:** Marcus is a member of #north-team, so I only used what he can already see there.
- **gbrain:** The brain refused the search because its connection isn't tied to any one member, so it read nothing. To fix it, whoever runs the brain's host server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. Until then, my answer rests only on the channel.
